scope: Eighty sentence-audited hard-stem genitive/locative plural tokens across 20 exact source forms: four in 44-book, 75 in the base papers, and one in the bibliography.
choice: Repair the exact mapped hard-stem forms from -ih to -yh while preserving all soft stems, personal and possessive pronouns, nouns, separate numeral paradigms, and unadjudicated look-alikes.
motivation: Official adjective morphology permits i after only soft š/ž/č/j stems; every mapped occurrence has a hard stem and genitive/locative plural syntax.
alternatives_rejected: A blanket *ih replacement was rejected because it would corrupt soft adjectives, participles, pronouns, nouns and separate numeral paradigms.
Retaining the 20 mixed hard-stem forms would preserve noncanonical agreement beside established -yh controls.
Unadjudicated někojih, njihovih and ljubih were excluded for separate semantic/morphological review.

evidence.adjective_grammar: Official adjectives.md lines 14 and 16 specifies regular agreement and y-to-i only after š/ž/č/j.
evidence.ordinal_grammar: Official numerals.md lines 73-75 treats prvy and drugy ordinals as hard-stem adjectives.
evidence.pronoun_grammar: Official pronouns.md lines 84, 97 and 101-107 treats ktory, kaky and regular indefinite derivatives adjectivally.
evidence.participle_grammar: Official verbs.md line 184 derives the hard past-passive -ty form, licensing genitive/locative plural vzętyh.
evidence.protected_domains: No mapped token occurs in a comment, foreign argument, URL or TeX control name.

validation.coverage: Exact source histogram totals 80 tokens over 20 types and the expected 4/0/75/1 file split.
validation.semantic_review: Every mapped occurrence was inspected as hard-stem genitive/locative plural agreement; packet holds are zero.
validation.postcondition: All 20 mapped old forms are zero and their exact canonical target counts rise by 80.
validation.structure: Byte counts, line counts, braces, ordered TeX controls and math delimiters are invariant; 45-isv.tex is byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: Frozen successor hashes reproduced twice before atomic application and matched after application.
